writeups: ventures/changepoint-detector/README.md "The panel word scored where it switches on"
goal: deepen flagship 4 with a pre-registered decision on the panel shape word
notes: Exploratory run (base 89000, 100/cell) showed the panel word hides slopes where it is in force; the pre-registration was committed (dbd77be5c) before the confirmatory run (base 93000, 400/cell, 80 cells, 32,000 panels). Bars 1, 2, 5 hold; 3 (slope lift -4.9 vs plain 21.9) and 4 (slope flag lift -14.7) fail, as predicted. Plain word stays default; --shape-word panel adds plainShape and gives both words where they differ; PANEL_SHAPE now quotes switched-panel rates (the old ones were pooled over panels where the rule was off). Verification: run_venture_tests.py changepoint-detector ok (914 tests, 178.9 s); page/synth-shape tests 36 pass after README/llms edits; check_posts ok; validate.py ok; venture-preflight.mjs changepoint-detector clean.
